title: Google and Xreal Launch Aura Wired XR Glasses Starting at $1,099

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google and Xreal have introduced the Aura, a pair of wired extended-reality glasses that run on the Android XR operating system. The device includes a processing puck equipped with a Snapdragon Reality Elite chip and will be sold for $1,099 through December, after which the price increases to $1,279.

The hardware enables users to create a private, multi-monitor digital workspace or view content on a large cinematic screen. Google's Gemini AI is integrated into the system to provide intelligent assistance directly within the glasses.
